purpose: Dense baseline on all eligible photographs, without artificial class balance
normalization: per-channel moments of all train RGB64 pixels; no sampling
checkpoint: maximum validation macro-F1; first epoch wins ties
early_stopping: stop after 5 successive epochs without validation loss decreasing by more than 0.0; different from checkpoint selection
primary_analysis: all three seeds; mean and sample standard deviation; no selection of best seed
test_policy: do not load or evaluate test images in this notebook
scope_limits: no optimizer, width or depth search; those are future registered ablations
validation is used for stopping and selection, so this is not a final unbiased estimate
no CNN trained yet: do not conclude architecture superiority
evaluation describes selected garment types after quality controls, not the whole catalog

cost_feasibility.decision: Keep every eligible train product if the measured upper estimate fits 90 minutes for six local CPU fits. Otherwise stop for an explicit computational amendment; no automatic photo cap.
